additional_info.subject: ID0418083-DC/Si-D/AT-[ Y2 / S9 313882469001] Error codes in the backend CRM:02684000076
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
Thanks for the feedback. Our colleagues didn't perform the reboot, there is a ticket from the 7/Apr but this reboot occured on the 8/Apr.
This is indeed strange, from our side I see this log:
And charger was completely operational:
What I can think of, is that the colleague from the previous ticket rebooted the charger to see if the PowerConverter error would go away. I asked the colleague to see if it's the case.
I'm not sure if you want to keep using this ticket for the PowerConverter error since the reboot must've come from someone. It's not possible to reboot without any interaction.
If you want to keep this ticket for the converter error, let me know how to proceed because customer is not aware of this error since that was not the initial question.
For the Converter what I recommend is to bring a spare converter and CAN cables to site and:
check if the CAN line is inserted properly and no visible damage and try again
If it still doesn't work, swap with a working neighbour converter
If it works then it might've been a loose connection
If the non-working converter is still not working → replace it
If the working converter is now not-working then it must be the CAN cables
If none of them are working then it's possible that it's the CAN cables and the converter.
Let me know what you think.
Best regards,
Francisco
